title: Joint End-to-End Training of Weighted BP Decoder Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2610.33559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensemble decoding improves decoding reliability by combining component decoders with complementary failure events. Existing approaches typically obtain this diversity from code-specific structure, such as code automorphisms, multiple parity-check representations, or targeted modifications of the message-passing graph. In this work, we instead learn the diversity of an ensemble of weighted belief propagation decoders by jointly optimizing trainable Tanner-graph edge weights. A central design question is how the training objective should distribute gradient among the ensemble members to promote complementary decoding behavior. To this end, we compare four ensemble objectives under direct gradient-based optimization and identify best-member training as the most effective approach. For a (64,32) progressive edge-growth (PEG) low-density parity-check (LDPC) code, the resulting ensemble outperforms the considered trained and untrained belief

translated_title: 加权置信传播解码器集成的联合端到端训练
translated_abstract: 集成解码通过组合具有互补失败事件的分量解码器来提高解码可靠性。现有方法通常从码的特定结构中获得这种多样性，例如码自同构、多种奇偶校验表示，或对消息传递图的有针对性修改。在本工作中，我们转而通过联合优化可训练的Tanner图边权重，来学习加权置信传播解码器集成的多样性。一个核心的设计问题是：训练目标应如何在集成成员之间分配梯度，以促进互补的解码行为。为此，我们在直接梯度优化下比较了四种集成训练目标，并确定最优成员训练是最有效的方法。对于一个(64,32)渐进边增长（PEG）低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码，所得的集成解码器性能优于所考虑的经过训练和未训练的置信传播解码器。
tldr: 该论文提出通过联合优化可训练的Tanner图边权重来端到端地训练加权置信传播解码器集成，并发现最优成员训练目标最能促进成员间互补的解码行为，使集成解码器在(64,32) PEG LDPC码上超越现有的训练与未训练置信传播解码器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes joint end-to-end training of weighted belief propagation decoder ensembles by optimizing trainable Tanner-graph edge weights, identifying best-member training as the most effective objective for promoting complementary decoding behavior and outperforming both trained and untrained BP decoders on a (64,32) PEG LDPC code.
